passages.exact_excerpt: | Other metadata | Preserve useful fields supported by the selected target format, including supported `compatibility` metadata. Record unsupported provider fields and preserve their substantive requirements in the contract. A checker-specific disagreement belongs to later validator assessment and is not a reason to discard supported metadata or run a checker during authoring. |
passages.intended_effect: Preserve supported metadata; defer checker disagreement

passages.exact_excerpt: Author one development skill and return a manual request for skill-validator. A clear current request authorizes creation or focused editing without a separately approved specification. Record requirements before generating files. Validation and testing belong to skill-validator; do not run structural checkers, graders, test suites, generated scripts as samples, cold trials, or automatic validator calls. Do not generate executable test campaigns during authoring. Further authorized edits may proceed while quality remains unperformed.
passages.intended_effect: Keep authoring and quality execution ownership distinct
